description: Rename a kube context via a RIGHT-CLICK 'Rename' item added to the EXISTING Pin/Unpin context menu in src/components/features/sidebar/SecondarySidebar.tsx (reuse its portal, styling, positioning, click-away close; NO hover pencil, NO new menu; ClusterList.tsx is dead code, leave it). Selecting it opens a small modal prefilled with the current name (Enter confirms, Esc cancels). Main process performs the equivalent of `kubectl config rename-context` on the real kubeconfig file(s) incl. current-context, then migrates pinnedClusters, active watchers, terminal override kubeconfigs and renderer state. Depends on FEAT-001 (kubeconfig-files.ts, refreshKubeConfig silent mode, cluster-context types, useClusterContexts hook, preload/d.ts wiring).
steps: Edit electron/kubeconfig-files.ts: add KubeconfigRenameError and renameContextInFiles(files, oldName, newName) -> {changedFiles, newName, renamedCurrentContext}. Validate: trim newName; non-empty; <=512 chars; no control chars (reuse isValidTerminalContext from electron/terminal-kubeconfig.ts); differs from old; not already present in ANY file's contexts; old present in at least one file. Read existing files with js-yaml load (non-object/multi-doc -> clear error), rename contexts[].name in every file defining old, set current-context to new wherever it equals old, dump with {lineWidth:-1, noRefs:true}. Write safely: realpath the target, stat mode, write temp file in the same dir with that mode, fsync, rename over target; stage all temps before renaming any; re-read and compare to the originally-read content right before rename and abort with a clear message if changed; write `<file>.lumen.bak` copy of the original (same mode) before replacing. Never leave temp files on failure.

Edit electron/k8s.ts: add renameContext(oldName, newName) -> {newName, clusters}: call renameContextInFiles(this.getKubeconfigFiles(), ...); if this.currentContext === old then stopAllWatchers() and set this.currentContext = new; re-key resourcePluralCache entries whose key starts with `${old}::`; call refreshKubeConfig({force:true, silent:true}) (wrapped in try/catch so a refresh failure does not mask a successful write) so the stored hash matches the file and NO k8s:contextsChanged is emitted for our own write; return getClusters() result.

Edit electron/terminal.ts: add optional `context` to PtySession (set via attach(sender, id, pty, kubeconfigFile, context) from createTerminal), add retargetContext(oldCtx, newCtx): for sessions with context === old and a kubeconfigFile, rewrite the file with buildContextKubeconfig(new) using fs.writeFileSync(..., {mode: 0o600}) and update session.context.

Edit electron/main.ts inside registerIpcHandlers(): safeHandle('k8s:renameContext', z.object({oldName: z.string().min(1).max(512), newName: z.string().max(512)}), async (_e, {oldName, newName}) => ...) -> call k8sService.renameContext; migrate store 'pinnedClusters' (replace old by new in place, dedupe, store.set); terminalService.retargetContext; getAuditLogger().log({action:'k8s:renameContext', category:'MUTATE', context: oldName, resourceName: newName, result:'success'}) mirroring the call shape in enforceMutationPolicy; return RenameClusterResult {ok:true,newName,clusters,pinnedClusters}; catch KubeconfigRenameError -> {ok:false,error:message}; any other error -> {ok:false, error:'Failed to rename context: ...'}.

Edit electron/preload.ts, electron/electron-env.d.ts, src/vite-env.d.ts: renameCluster: (oldName: string, newName: string) => ipcRenderer.invoke('k8s:renameContext', { oldName, newName }) typed as Promise<RenameClusterResult>.

Create src/utils/cluster-rename-utils.ts (pure): renameMapKey<T>(map, old, new) (returns whether moved; merges nothing if new exists), remapPanelTab(tab, old, new) (updates clusterContext and execContext.context), replaceInList(list, old, new).

Create src/components/shared/RenameClusterModal.tsx: props {isOpen, currentName, existingNames, onConfirm(newName): Promise<string|null>, onCancel}. Mirror src/components/shared/ConfirmModal.tsx structure; z-[200], backdrop bg-black/20 backdrop-blur-sm, panel bg-white/5 border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-xl p-4+ shadow-2xl, input bg-black/40 border border-white/10 rounded-lg text-white font-mono focus:border-blue-500/50, GlassButton primary 'Rename' + secondary 'Cancel', framer-motion fade/scale. Autofocus and select all on open, Enter confirms, Esc cancels (also on backdrop click), disabled when trimmed value empty/unchanged/duplicate of existingNames, busy state while awaiting onConfirm, closes only when onConfirm resolves null (error string keeps it open).

Edit src/components/features/sidebar/SecondarySidebar.tsx: in the EXISTING context-menu portal block (after the Pin button, same classes) add a 'Rename' button with lucide Pencil icon that sets renameTarget = contextMenu.cluster and setContextMenu(null); increase `menuHeight` in handleContextMenu from 50 to fit two items (~84); add `renameTarget` state, render <RenameClusterModal> and add prop `onRenameCluster?: (oldName: string, newName: string) => Promise<string | null>`.

Edit src/App.tsx: add handleRenameCluster(old, new) -> Promise<string|null>: call window.k8s.renameCluster; if !ok -> showToast(error,'error') and return error; if ok -> setPinnedClusters(result.pinnedClusters), applyClusters(result.clusters), if selectedCluster===old setSelectedCluster(new) (this makes Dashboard restart its watchers with the new name), same for attemptedCluster, renameMapKey on viewTabsByClusterRef and editorTabsByClusterRef then bumpViewTabs()/bumpEditorTabs(), setPanelTabs(prev => prev.map(t => remapPanelTab(t, old, new))), showToast(`Renamed ${old} to ${new}`,'success'), return null. Pass onRenameCluster to SecondarySidebar. Change the toast container class from z-[100] to z-[300] so errors show above the z-[200] modal.
acceptance_criteria: Right-clicking a cluster in the cluster list shows the existing menu now containing 'Pin/Unpin Cluster' and 'Rename'; no hover pencil and no second menu were added; ClusterList.tsx unchanged
Choosing Rename opens a modal prefilled with the current name; Enter confirms, Esc cancels

After confirming, the kubeconfig file contains the new context name (equivalent to kubectl config rename-context), current-context follows if it matched, and clusters/users/namespaces/extensions/other contexts are unchanged and file mode is preserved

Empty, whitespace-only, unchanged, duplicate, control-char names and a missing old context are rejected in main with a clear message shown via ToastNotification (visible above the modal) and the file is untouched
pinnedClusters store entry, selected/attempted cluster, per-cluster view/editor tabs, panel tabs, running context-bound terminals and active watchers all migrate to the new name
The rename's own file write does not trigger a k8s:contextsChanged event or a second list refresh/flicker
verification: npx eslint on each touched/new file; no new errors on lines written

Throwaway vitest (delete after) on temp copies of a multi-context kubeconfig: rename works, current-context updated, parsed-object equality for everything else, mode preserved, .lumen.bak written, invalid inputs throw the documented messages and leave file byte-identical, two-file KUBECONFIG chain renames only in the defining file(s), no temp files left behind
findings: Implemented per steps; nothing committed. Right-click 'Rename' (lucide Pencil) added inside the EXISTING Pin/Unpin portal menu in SecondarySidebar.tsx (menuHeight 50->84, renameTarget state, new onRenameCluster prop); no hover pencil, no new menu, ClusterList.tsx untouched. Files: electron/kubeconfig-files.ts (KubeconfigRenameError, renameContextInFiles; stages all temps, re-reads/compares originals before swap, writes <file>.lumen.bak, realpath for symlinks, skips missing/empty files in a KUBECONFIG chain, rolls back swapped files on failure), electron/k8s.ts renameContext(), electron/terminal.ts (PtySession.context, attach(...,context), retargetContext), electron/main.ts ('k8s:renameContext' via safeHandle, pinnedClusters migrated in place+deduped, retarget terminals, audit log MUTATE, discriminated result; not Safe-Mode gated), preload.ts + electron-env.d.ts + src/vite-env.d.ts (renameCluster), src/utils/cluster-rename-utils.ts (renameMapKey, remapPanelTab, replaceInList - replaceInList currently unused; main.ts does the same inline), src/components/shared/RenameClusterModal.tsx (portaled to document.body because sidebar ancestors use backdrop-filter; z-[200]; Enter/Esc/backdrop; disabled for empty/unchanged/duplicate; stays open on error string), src/App.tsx (handleRenameCluster, applyClusters from the hook, migrates selected/attempted cluster, view/editor tab maps, panelTabs; toast container z-[100]->z-[300]). Verification: tsc --noEmit reports only a pre-existing/unrelated error in untracked electron/resource-cache/list-watch.test.ts (not from this work); eslint clean on new files, no new errors on lines written in terminal.ts/preload.ts/SecondarySidebar.tsx (only pre-existing any/escape issues); throwaway vitest 13/13 passed on temp kubeconfigs (rename, current-context, parsed-equality, mode 0640 on file+bak, .lumen.bak, invalid inputs byte-identical, two-file chain, symlink, missing file, bad YAML, no temp files) and was deleted. Not verified in a running app (dev server not run): the no-extra-contextsChanged behavior relies on refreshKubeConfig({force:true,silent:true}) updating the stored hash, and exec terminals (kubectl exec --context old) cannot be retargeted - only their tab metadata is remapped. Known minor: clusterToUnpin in App.tsx is not remapped if an unpin confirm dialog is open during rename.
